fields.summary_ko.0: Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC) has declined more than 5% since early October, but according to historical patterns, there is a high likelihood of a rebound in 2027 driven by AI's productivity gains.
fields.summary_ko.1: Seagate Technology (STX) fell 31% over the recent three months, but benefiting from AI data center deployments, Q1 revenue reached $4.23 billion, a 61% increase year-over-year.
fields.summary_ko.2: Seagate's storage solutions including HDDs and SSDs support large dataset storage for AI model training, with non-GAAP operating margin reaching 50.7%.
